limitations: Original research organization authored for this user-authorized #11 source-exhaustion session. This is a finite source-qualification inventory, not a new engineering registry, unrestricted data licence, or an assertion that the entire Internet or all histories have been exhausted.

The frozen publishable inventory is split at record boundaries without removing or rewriting any inventory field. First part holds the complete group metadata; all parts together reconstruct the original parsed JSON exactly. File and canonical logical digests distinguish formatting from content.

Source family, data product, endpoint, observation and publisher counts have different denominators. Original upstreams, mirrors, inherited sources, overlapping series, access failures and rights conditions remain in each record. Do not sum group counts as independent licensed feeds.

Local acquisition receipts and even HTTP 200 are separate from verified numeric files, native SourceInput custody and executed consumers. Any runtime status in the frozen researcher inventory is its qualification-stage statement; the root session actual write/read overlay is recorded separately.

Publication filters remove explicitly restricted numerical samples as documented in each group. Public page visibility, necessary factual excerpts or a catalogue licence do not grant unrestricted redistribution or a direct upstream service subscription. No continuous collection, alerts, market orders or adopted investment decisions are created.

Any local filenames or transient research reference tokens embedded in the audit metadata are historical investigation locators, not durable source URIs. Original public URLs, bytes and SHA-256 receipts remain the source attribution; the actual saved manifest is the durable reference for this inventory.
